title: Scatter, Rails, Trails, Foil & Fans
description: Five patterns built on shared physics — a parallax scatter gallery, a spring-glided scrollspy rail, a decaying variable-font trail, holographic foil cards, and a shared-spring toast fan.

drops.title: Scatter Flow Gallery
drops.description: An infinite, velocity-blurred photo grid where images drift at their own depth speed and flip open into a fullscreen detail view.
drops.concept: Reimplements Codrops' infinite parallax scroll gallery technique: a wrapping grid of tiles drifts at per-tile depth speeds, gains motion blur proportional to scroll velocity, and uses a FLIP (First-Last-Invert-Play) transform animation to expand a clicked tile into a fullscreen detail view instead of a layout-based transition.
drops.source: Codrops — "Building an Infinite GSAP Scroll Gallery with Parallax and Flip Transitions"

interaction.mouse: Scroll to drift the grid at multiple depths, hover to lift a tile
interaction.click: Flips the tile open into a fullscreen detail view
interaction.touch: Swipe/scroll drifts the grid; tap opens the detail view

drops.title: Scrollspy Rail
drops.description: A sticky section-index rail whose magnetic indicator pill physically glides — with spring overshoot — to track your reading position.
drops.concept: Reimagines lightweight scrollspy navigation as a floating glass rail: an IntersectionObserver watches each section and drives a real spring simulation (position, velocity, stiffness, damping) so the active-label indicator glides and settles instead of snapping.

interaction.mouse: Scroll the article; the rail label and pill track the active section
interaction.click: Click a rail label to jump to its section
interaction.touch: Tap a label to jump; the pill tracks scroll live

drops.title: Glyph Weight Trail
drops.description: Move the cursor across a headline and leave a decaying trail of shifting font weight, width and glow.
drops.concept: Extends the common variable-font cursor-proximity effect with memory: each glyph tracks a per-frame decaying "energy" value pushed up by cursor proximity and decayed exponentially every frame, so the weight/scale/glow response lingers and fades behind the cursor instead of snapping back instantly.

interaction.mouse: Move across any headline to bend nearby glyphs' weight and leave a fading trail
interaction.click: Tune decay rate and influence radius in the debug panel
interaction.touch: Drag a finger across the text for the same trailing effect

drops.title: Holo Foil Cards
drops.description: Trading-card style holographic foil that tilts, glares, and rainbow-shifts in 3D as you move over it.
drops.concept: Reimplements the pointer-reactive holographic card trend: 3D tilt driven by pointer position within the card, a moving specular glare layer, and a rainbow foil gradient whose angle shifts with tilt so different orientations reveal different color bands.

interaction.mouse: Move over a card to tilt it and sweep the glare and foil
interaction.click: Tune max tilt angle and glare intensity in the debug panel
interaction.touch: Drag a finger over a card for the same tilt and foil response

drops.title: Spring Toast Fan
drops.description: Stacked toast notifications fan into a scaled pile on one shared spring, then collapse back in unison.
drops.concept: Recreates Motion UI's toast-stack pattern: every toast in the pile reads from a single shared spring value, so opening or collapsing the pile moves every toast together with the same overshoot and settle, instead of each toast animating independently.

interaction.mouse: Click buttons to push toasts; hover the pile to fan it open
interaction.click: Dismiss a toast with its × button
interaction.touch: Tap to push toasts; tap the pile to fan it open, tap × to dismiss
